name: IRCON International Ltd
title: IRCON International Ltd - 541956 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Order book ~Rs.24,984 cr (~2.6x FY26 revenue of Rs.9,502 cr) but management guides FY27 revenue flat at ~Rs.9,000 cr and standalone core EBITDA down to 4.0-4.5%, with bids going below estimate and win rate rising to 10% of value bid.

triggers.label: Revenue guide cut to ~Rs.9,000 cr
triggers.quote: we had given a guidance of 10,000 to 11,000 crore revenue, but we are presently sitting in the range of about 9,000 crores

triggers.label: Standalone core EBITDA 4.0-4.5%
triggers.quote: some of the bids are going much below the estimate. So, at core EBITDA levels, we expect it to be in the range of about 4. 0 to 4.2 percent

triggers.label: Win rate 5.7% → 10% of value bid
triggers.quote: in 2025-2026, we got around 10% of what we bided

triggers.label: 107 bids worth ~Rs.48,000 cr
triggers.quote: We submitted 107 bids for around Rs.48,000 crores

guidance.quote: the guidance would be similar levels as FY26
it would stay in the level of 4%-4.5% at core EBITDA level on standalone basis
we would be able to maintain PAT at console level in the range of about 6.1 to 6.3 percent

guidance.value: Rs.700-800 crore total, Rs.500-600 crore in FY27
guidance.quote: The total requirement we anticipate is about Rs.700 to Rs.800 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: we had given a guidance of 10,000 to 11,000 crore revenue, but we are presently sitting in the range of about 9,000 crores
